definitions.explanation: Mimetic word describing cautious, shy behavior when approaching something or someone with nervousness or uncertainty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おずおず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
おずおず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I ask a question? (said timidly)

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おずおず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

notes:
TYPE: Mimetic word (gitaigo) describing manner or attitude. Almost always used as おずおずと before a verb.

NUANCE: Shyness or nervousness, lack of confidence, caution born of uncertainty, hesitation before acting.

TYPICAL SUBJECTS: children meeting strangers, new employees, anyone in an unfamiliar or intimidating situation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- おずおずと + verb: describes a hesitant action
- Frequent verbs: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ (raise one's hand), ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ (approach), ⟦{話|はな}しかける→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧ (speak to), ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (enter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おどおど→おどおど：05371_odoodo⟧ - nervous, unsettled manner (visible anxiety)
- ⟦びくびく→びくびく：05266_bikubiku⟧ - timid from fear of something specific
- ⟦もじもじ→もじもじ：06274_mojimoji⟧ - fidgeting from embarrassment
- ⟦{恐|おそ}る{恐|おそ}る→恐る恐る：12609_osoruosoru⟧ - fearfully, gingerly (physical caution)
- ⟦ためらいがち→ためらいがち：noentry⟧ - hesitantly (more formal, from ⟦ためらう→ためらう：06034_tamerau⟧)
- おずおず: a timid, tentative approach
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: confidently, boldly
